verdict.rationale: Replicate presents itself as API-first ('Run AI with an API'). Its docs say running, fine-tuning and deploying custom models all work through code, and there are language quickstarts such as Node.js. Nothing documents full API–UI parity: cost estimates appear on the model's page, metrics and logs are not shown as API-accessible, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. missing for 10: explicit statement or evidence of full UI/API parity, API access to metrics/logs/cost estimates and account management, a published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
